info.title: RSI Dreambox API
info.description: Local admin control for portable LOOP2. Pocket packages contain raw facts. Dream and schedule features are Under development behind a default-off server flag. The owner opens it after the pocket-OFF recall bar passes; enabled checks return manual preparation plans, never training execution.
